card.title: CBP Air and Marine Operations and Border Patrol Perform Multiple Rescues in Southwest Arizona
card.description: YUMA, Ariz. – Air and Marine Operations—Yuma Air Branch working with Yuma and Tucson Sector Border Patrol, located and rescued two separate groups of people in need in southwestern Arizona Thursday.
